# Calendar link with login per frame, full appointment reader
### New
- **Calendar link with login, per frame:** *Devices → ⚙ → Calendar* now has **user and password** next to the calendar link, for protected calendars such as Radicale or Nextcloud. Every frame can show its own calendar with its own login; the login applies only to that frame's own link, is stored on the server only and is never shown again. `webcal://` links are accepted. Unlike the phone route, this does not depend on iOS waking the app in the background.
### Changed
- **The calendar link is now read completely** (new libraries `icalendar` and `recurring-ical-events`): all repeat rules (including **monthly**), **excluded days**, **moved single appointments** and **multi-day** all-day events; cancelled appointments are no longer shown. If a file cannot be read this way, the previous simple reader takes over.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
